iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.description: Every blow you take feeds the super, even one a shield soaks.

braced_charge.name: Braced Charge
braced_charge.description: Shield Charge ends with you behind a shield of your own.

heavy_rhythm.name: Heavy Rhythm
heavy_rhythm.description: Ground Slam is ready a quarter sooner.

wardens_resolve.name: Warden's Resolve
wardens_resolve.description: Each kill closes your wounds and fills the super.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Blows out of hiding land harder still.

light_feet.name: Light Feet
light_feet.description: Shadowstep is ready a quarter sooner.

bloodtrail.name: Bloodtrail
bloodtrail.description: Every kill brings your step back two seconds sooner.

wardens_shade.name: Warden's Shade
wardens_shade.description: Each kill readies your bomb sooner and fills the super.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.description: Whatever dies in your fire gives its last ember to the next pot: three seconds off its cooldown.

quick_flame.name: Quick Flame
quick_flame.description: Repel is ready a quarter sooner.

wardens_pyre.name: Warden's Pyre
wardens_pyre.description: Whatever dies in your fire warms you, and every pot you throw wraps you in heat.
